Q5910.reason: A recorded ban on building on a utility strip is a restriction on the servient owner's use, which fits a negative easement and complements the affirmative utility easement in restriction (22).

Q5623.reason: The commentary was opinion about a newsworthy public event and a public figure, with no false statement of fact and no actual malice, so the professor likely loses.

Q5004.reason: The class gift to the sister's children at age 25 can vest more than 21 years after all lives in being, because a child born late in her life could reach 25 after that period, so it violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and the friend takes alone.
